basic_profile.bio: I'm a passionate trader in the world of virtual pets and items, with a particular love for Adopt Me and Pokémon games. Based in the Midwest, I balance my time between my job as a special education teacher and my hobbies in online trading and podcast discussions. I'm a big fan of Gunna and enjoy listening to MacrodosingPod during my daily commute. Typically online in the evenings, especially after dinner, when I catch up on trading deals and new music releases. In a relationship, but we both love our own hobbies, giving each other plenty of space.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in special education, I've developed a strong understanding of personalized learning strategies and communication skills. My interest in trading virtual items has driven me to self-teach about market dynamics and negotiation tactics. I also have a keen interest in music, often exploring new artists and genres.
